notes.title: Small Patch to Version 0.5.3
notes.content: A typo was found in the description of Defiance which has now been fixed. The targets now move horizontally for an added challenge. Movement was always intended and more changes will be added in the future. Thank you.

notes.title: Space Time Version 0.5.3
notes.content:
- Fixed Various Bugs
- Added an Options Menu
- Moved Invert Y + X to the new Options Menu
- Added Volume controls to the new Options Menu (All settings save)
- Rebuilt the Main Menu from the ground up
- Added Full Controller Support
- New Multiplayer Game Mode called Head-2-Head has been added and can be played locally or online through Steam's Remote Play Together.


Thank you all so much for your support and interest in my game. It means a lot to me since I am a new Indie Dev just starting out. I can't wait to start working on my next project after the holidays and look forward to many more. Happy Holidays from my family to yours.      -Sean
